model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата е предназначена да илюстрира промените в средните стойности на скритите състояния спрямо слоя. 
Оста X е обозначена като "Layer", скалата е линейна, диапазонът на стойностите е от 0 до 22, без да са посочени единици. Етикетите са разположени на интервали от 5, като са означены с числови стойности 0, 5, 10, 15 и 20. 
Оста Y е обозначена като "Abs Mean", скалата е линейна, диапазонът на стойностите е от 0 до 4, без да са посочени единици. Етикетите са разположени на интервали от 1, като са означены с числови стойности 0, 1, 2, 3 и 4. 
Графиката съдържа три линии, всяка от които е свързана със средната стойност на скритото състояние на различни етапи: 
- Пунктираната синя линия показва средната стойност преди гейт (hidden state mean before gate). Тя започва близо до 0 при слой 0 и се увеличава до около 4.2 при слой 22, с относително рязък скок след слой 19.
- Пунктираната оранжева линия показва средната стойност след гейт (hidden state mean after gate). Тя започва близо до 0 при слой 0 и се увеличава леко до около 0.1 при слой 22. 
- Плътната зелена линия показва средната стойност на базовата линия (hidden state mean of baseline). Тя остава близо до 0 през всички слоеве, като леко се увеличава от около 0 до около 0.1 при слой 22.
model_annotations.Chinese:
The line graph displays the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers, comparing three conditions: before gate, after gate, and baseline. 
The x-axis represents Layer, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22, marked at intervals of 5 units. 
The y-axis represents Abs Mean, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4, marked at intervals of 1 unit. 
The graph shows three lines: a blue dashed line representing the hidden state mean before gate, starting at approximately 0.1 and rising sharply to around 4.2 at layer 22; a red dotted line representing the hidden state mean after gate, staying near 0; and a green solid line representing the hidden state mean of baseline, also staying near 0. The average values for each line are provided as 0.71 for the blue line, 0.05 for the red line, and 0.04 for the green line.
model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the hidden state mean across different layers. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," has a linear scale with a value range of 0 to approximately 23 and is marked with tick labels at regular intervals of 5, with no units specified. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," also has a linear scale, with a value range of 0 to 4 and is marked with tick labels at intervals of 1, with no units specified. The plot contains three lines: a blue dashed line representing the hidden state mean before gate, an orange dotted line representing the hidden state mean after gate, and a green solid line representing the hidden state mean of baseline. The blue line starts at approximately 0.1 and fluctuates around 0.5 until layer 18, then sharply increases to around 4 at layer 22. The orange and green lines both start at 0 and remain relatively stable, hovering around 0, with slight fluctuations.
model_annotations.German: This diagram shows a line graph with the title "Hidden State Mean" and displays three lines representing different hidden state means. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and has a range from 0 to 23, with tick labels at regular intervals of 5, and no units are specified. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and has a range from 0 to 4, with no units specified, and tick labels at regular intervals of 1. The diagram shows three lines: a blue dashed line representing "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71", an orange dotted line representing "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05", and a green solid line representing "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04". The blue line starts at approximately 0.2 and increases to around 4.1, the orange line starts at approximately 0.02 and remains relatively stable around 0.05, and the green line starts at approximately 0.02 and remains relatively stable around 0.04.
